INVALID_PATH.message: Path is not canonical or contains unsafe components.

PATH_TOO_LONG.message: Path exceeds the maximum allowed length.

EMPTY_SEGMENT.message: Empty path segment is not allowed.

RESERVED_CHAR.message: Path segment contains a reserved character.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.message: File exceeds the maximum allowed size.

PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE.message: Package exceeds the maximum allowed size.

MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE.message: Manifest exceeds the maximum allowed size.

DECODE_BUDGET.message: Decoded data exceeds the configured resource budget.

LENGTH_MISMATCH.message: Decoded data length does not match authenticated metadata.

OVERLAPPING_SECTION.message: Package sections overlap or cover protected metadata.

UNSUPPORTED_CODEC.message: Package uses an unsupported or invalid codec.

BAD_RESOURCE_MAP.message: Manifest resources do not match package sections.

SIGNATURE_REQUIRED.message: A valid package signature is required.

DICTIONARY_MISMATCH.message: Compression dictionary identity does not match authenticated metadata.

LICENSE_MISMATCH.message: Asset license or provenance metadata does not match packaged content.
